name: DB RIS Routing
description: German rail journey planning via DB RIS API

dataSources.purpose: Deutsche Bahn's official journey planner for multi-modal transit routing in Germany
dataSources.dataSent: Origin and destination coordinates, departure or arrival time, language
dataSources.dataReceived: Trips with legs (WALK/JOURNEY/CONNECT), transport category/line/number, Google-encoded polylines, per-stop scheduled/actual times and platforms
